name: pi-one-ui
description: A single, customizable Pi UI package combining Zentui shell chrome with Claude Code-style transcript rendering.

scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:vitest
scripts.test:node: node --test tests/config.test.ts tests/config-store.test.ts tests/header-*.test.ts tests/one-ui-integration.test.ts tests/runtime-infrastructure.test.ts tests/transcript-*.test.ts
scripts.format: biome format --write extensions tests package.json tsconfig.json biome.json
scripts.format:check: biome format extensions tests package.json tsconfig.json biome.json
scripts.lint: biome check extensions/index.ts extensions/app/panel.ts extensions/app/presets.ts package.json tsconfig.json biome.json
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
